harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1–node3 to forward only local0 messages over mutual TLS to node4 on TCP 6514. Node4 stores logs by source under /var/log/remote/<node>/application.log, rejects unrelated facilities and cleartext traffic, and performs daily rotation with seven compressed generations.
actions_performed: Installed version-matched rsyslog GnuTLS support on all four nodes.
Generated a private CA/server identity on node4 and separate locally generated client keys and certificates on node1–node3.
Configured authenticated TLS forwarding with persistent queues and infinite retry.
Configured node4’s TLS-only listener, per-source local0 ruleset, firewall access, and protected key permissions.
Configured and behaviorally tested daily log rotation, seven-generation retention, compression, and post-rotation delivery.

evidence.requirement: All three senders deliver local0 messages over TLS to node4:6514
evidence.summary: Each sender completed a CA-verified TLS handshake and emitted a unique local0 token; node4 received all three through established 6514 sessions.

evidence.requirement: Store source-identifiable application logs and exclude unrelated facilities
evidence.summary: Local0 tokens appeared in separate node1, node2, and node3 application.log files. Corresponding user-facility tokens were absent from the entire central remote-log tree.
A raw non-TLS syslog frame was rejected with an unexpected TLS packet error and never logged. Final listener inspection showed only rsyslog TLS port 6514, with no TCP/UDP 514 or TCP 601 listener.

evidence.requirement: Rotate application logs daily, retain at least seven rotations, and compress
evidence.summary: The policy parses as daily, rotate 7, compress. A forced cycle produced valid .1.gz archives for all sources, rsyslog remained active, fresh messages reached new logs, and the persistent daily logrotate timer is enabled and active.

evidence.requirement: Configuration remains valid, enabled, and persistent
evidence.summary: All four rsyslog configurations pass validation; services are active and enabled. Final configuration shows local0-only TLS forwarding, x509 peer authorization, persistent queues, node4’s TLS ruleset, firewall state, protected keys, and current/rotated logs.
